**NHS AI scribes get drug names and diagnoses wrong, and patients are the ones catching it.** Healthwatch England reports cases where consultation-transcription tools recorded a wrong diagnosis or confused similarly named drugs, spotted by the patient rather than the clinician. Doctors in England already use 27 different AI scribes, and the medicines regulator has decided not to classify them as medical devices. [The Guardian, 31 Aug 2026](https://www.theguardian.com/society/2026/aug/31/doctors-ai-scribes-get-names-of-drugs-and-diagnoses-wrong-nhs-watchdog-warns)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-ai-meeting-minutes-doubled" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/ai-meeting-minutes-doubled/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="AI meeting minutes doubled one PM&#x27;s effort." markdown>

**AI meeting minutes doubled one PM's effort.** A PM on complex projects went from under 30 minutes to at least an hour per one-hour meeting: checking the AI summary against the recording, simplifying it, then fixing residual errors, while the team does not read default Teams summaries anyway. Fixes offered in replies: train a Claude skill on transcripts plus your own notes over two or three meetings, or minute only decisions, actions and owners. [Reddit r/projectmanagement, 27 Aug 2026](https://www.reddit.com/r/projectmanagement/comments/1w0383c/please_tell_me_honestly_how_long_it_takes_you_to/)
